title: Dear Protest…
description: Dear Protest, Are you okay? There was a time when this question was asked only to people. These days, it seems to be asked of the country. I picked up the morning paper, and there you were. From the front page to the gossip columns, everyone had an opinion on you. A little later, I sipped my tea as I scrolled on Instagram. Same story. Every other post, every other reel, there you were again. That’s when I began to worry. I tried the television next. Surely you’d be there somewhere too, buried be
